script_text: Stop, Aquarius — Uranus just fired a disruptive square to Mars, and your world is about to tilt. Your ruling planet Uranus in Taurus is clashing with Mars in Aries, igniting your 9th House of Expansion and stirring your Air element into restless energy. Meanwhile, Mercury conjoins the Sun in your 10th House of Career, demanding you speak up. In love, Venus trine Uranus in your 5th House of Romance is pulling you toward someone unexpected — if single, say yes to the unconventional; if taken, a secret admirer surfaces today. Professionally, Mercury's conjunction with the Sun in your 10th House pushes a long-overdue conversation with authority figures — negotiate boldly, not defensively. Warning: avoid signing any contract before noon when the Moon enters Scorpio and clouds your judgment. Subscribe so you don't miss what Saturn does to your 2nd House of Income next week.
